metadata.name: Hansonism
metadata.scope: The contemporary political doctrine expressed by Pauline Hanson’s One Nation programme, not Hanson’s entire personal record or an unchanged version of the 1998 platform.
metadata.description: An Australian national-populist doctrine associated with One Nation, advocating lower immigration, a common national culture, sovereign decision-making and domestic economic priorities. This assessment covers its contemporary platform.
metadata.phrase: Society should retain a common Australian culture and national control of its borders and decisions, with lower immigration, support for domestic jobs and industries, and more direct public influence over government.
